name: Brazil
summary: Brazil is not a contracting party to the 1958 UNECE Agreement. Vehicle lighting is governed by Resolução CONTRAN nº 970/2022 (with annexes, in force since 1 Jul 2022, most recently amended only in Art. 6 by Res. 1.024/2026). Its installation rules largely match UN R48, and for the components it refers either to its own annexes or to UN R7, R23, R3 and R38. Market access is granted through vehicle homologation (CAT and RENAVAM code from SENATRAN under Portaria SENATRAN nº 990/2022) based on a manufacturer declaration and archived test reports. Test results under UN regulations or FMVSS are accepted as alternative proof of performance (Art. 14), but E-approvals are not mutually recognised. Key difference from UN R48: the emergency stop signal (ESS) is mandatory.

standards.title: Dispõe sobre as características e especificações técnicas dos sistemas de sinalização, de iluminação e seus dispositivos, bem como sobre o uso de lanternas especiais em veículos
standards.scope: Main regulation for lighting and light-signalling devices (passenger cars, commercial vehicles, trailers, motorcycles). In force since 1 Jul 2022 (Art. 21); replaces, among others, Res. 667/2017 (Art. 20) and Res. 227/2007 (from 1 Jan 2024, Art. 19). Annexes I-XVI apply to vehicles produced or imported from 1 Jan 2021 (Art. 16). Art. 14: test results under UN regulations (ONU/UNECE) or FMVSS are accepted as an alternative. Amended by Res. CONTRAN nº 1.024/2026 (Art. 6 only, vehicles with special warning lamps).

standards.title: Instalação de dispositivos de iluminação e sinalização luminosa
standards.scope: Installation rules (structurally equivalent to UN R48): item 4.4 reversing lamps, 4.7 stop lamps incl. high-mounted stop lamp S3/S4 (mandatory for M1), 4.10 rear position lamps, 4.11 rear fog lamp (optional), 4.14 rear retro-reflectors (non-triangular), 4.17/4.18 side retro-reflectors/side marker lamps (mandatory only above 6 m length), 4.21 emergency stop signal (mandatory).

standards.title: Lanternas de posição dianteira e traseira (lateral), lanternas de freio e lanternas delimitadoras
standards.scope: Component requirements for rear position and stop lamps (photometry, colour). As an alternative, Anexo I items 4.7.10 and 4.10 allow 'Regulamento nº 7 das Nações Unidas'.

standards.title: Lanternas de marcha-à-ré
standards.scope: Component requirements for reversing lamps. As an alternative, Anexo I item 4.4.10 allows 'Regulamento nº 23 das Nações Unidas'.

standards.title: Retrorrefletores
standards.scope: Component requirements for retro-reflectors (class IA/IB for rear retro-reflectors). As an alternative, Anexo I item 4.14.8 allows 'Regulamento n°3 das Nações Unidas'.

standards.title: Procedimento para homologação de veículos e equipamentos veiculares, concessão do código de marca/modelo/versão do RENAVAM e emissão do Certificado de Adequação à Legislação de Trânsito (CAT)
standards.scope: Homologation procedure for all new domestic and imported vehicles (Art. 2). Annex XI: 'Dispositivos de Iluminação' (Res. 227/2007, 667/2017 or 970/2022) belong to the test reports of control level 'Nível 2' (active safety), stating the test laboratory.

standards.title: Regulamentos Técnicos da Qualidade e Requisitos de Avaliação da Conformidade para Componentes Automotivos - Consolidado
standards.scope: Mandatory certification of certain automotive components for the aftermarket, including filament bulbs of listed categories (e.g. P21W, P21/5W, W5W, W21W, W21/5W, R5W). Exempt: components for the vehicle assembly line (Art. 3 § 7 I). Complete lamps are not listed.

certification.scheme: CAT (Certificado de Adequação à Legislação de Trânsito) + código marca/modelo/versão RENAVAM (SENATRAN)
certification.type: government vehicle homologation based on manufacturer declaration (Certificado de Segurança) and archived test reports; no separate component approval for rear lamps
certification.marking: No national approval mark for rear lamps found in Res. CONTRAN 970/2022; an E-mark does not grant approval, as Brazil is not a contracting party to the 1958 Agreement. Replacement bulbs of listed categories need the INMETRO conformity seal (Portaria Inmetro 145/2022).
certification.summary: Manufacturers, importers, body builders and converters apply to SENATRAN (via SISCAT or SEI) for the CAT and the RENAVAM code for every new vehicle model or version; the fee is R$ 266 per CAT and processing takes up to 60 days. In the Certificado de Segurança, the manufacturer, together with a responsible engineer (CREA), declares compliance with all regulations and must present the test reports on request (for lighting: control level Nível 2, stating the test laboratory, plus a declaration on the management system that controls the laboratory work). Under Art. 14 Res. 970/2022, test results may alternatively be provided under UN regulations or FMVSS.

notes: accepts_un_approvals = false because there is no mutual recognition of UN type approvals (E-marks) and Brazil is not on the UN list of contracting parties to the 1958 Agreement. However, Res. CONTRAN 970/2022 Art. 14 allows test results under UN regulations as alternative proof of performance in the CAT procedure, and the annexes explicitly refer to UN R7, R23, R3 and R38. The annexes of Res. 970 were read from the DOU version (copy on abti.org.br) because the annex file was not found on gov.br. That Res. 970 is still in force in October 2026 is based on Res. 1.024 of 26 Jun 2026 (DOU 1 Jul 2026) amending it; amendments published later were not checked.

deviations.topic: Vehicle homologation (CAT/SENATRAN) instead of UN type approval
deviations.national_requirement: Every new domestic or imported vehicle model needs a make/model/version code in RENAVAM and a CAT from SENATRAN (Portaria SENATRAN 990/2022, Art. 2). In the Certificado de Segurança (Annex VI, with a responsible CREA engineer), the manufacturer or importer declares that all regulations are met. For 'Dispositivos de Iluminação' under Res. CONTRAN 970/2022, test reports of control level Nível 2 stating the test laboratory must be kept on file, together with a declaration that a management system controls the laboratory work (Annex XI, items 1.3/1.4). E-approvals are not recognised automatically.
deviations.suggestion: Prepare a Brazil test dossier for the OEM or importer for the CAT procedure: test reports under Res. CONTRAN 970/2022 Annexes VI, IV and XII or under UN R7, R23 and R3 (alternatively FMVSS), each clearly stating the test laboratory and with proof of the management system that controls the laboratory work. Agree early on which documents go into the SISCAT application.

deviations.topic: Brazil refers to UN R7/R23/R3, not to R148/R150
deviations.national_requirement: Res. CONTRAN 970/2022 Annex I requires for each component either its own annex or a specific UN regulation: rear position and stop lamp 'Anexo VI ... ou Regulamento nº 7', reversing lamp 'Anexo IV ... ou Regulamento nº 23', rear retro-reflector 'Anexo XII ... ou Regulamento n°3', rear fog lamp 'Anexo VIII ... ou Regulamento nº 38'. UN R148 and R150 are not mentioned in the text. Art. 14 generally allows test results under 'Regulamentos Técnicos das Nações Unidas (ONU/UNECE)'.
deviations.suggestion: Add a mapping to the conformity documentation: R148 → Res. 970 Annex VI/IV or UN R7/R23, and R150 → Annex XII or UN R3. Get the OEM or SENATRAN to confirm in advance that R148/R150 test reports are accepted under Art. 14; otherwise plan an additional test under Annexes VI, IV and XII.
deviations.notes: It is confirmed which regulations are named. Whether SENATRAN readily accepts test reports under R148/R150 via Art. 14 is not explicitly stated in the sources reviewed.

deviations.national_requirement: Res. CONTRAN 970/2022 Annex I item 4.21.1: the emergency stop signal is mandatory for motor vehicles; in UN R48 (item 6.23.1) it is optional. All stop lamps and/or direction indicators flash in sync at 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz, or at 4.0 +0.0/−1.0 Hz if the rear lamps use filament bulbs (item 4.21.7.1). The signal is activated automatically and only above 50 km/h. Under Art. 16, the requirement has also applied since 1 Jan 2024 to vehicle projects whose code was issued before 1 Jan 2021.
deviations.suggestion: Specify under 'Function' that the stop lamp function can flash in sync at 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz for the emergency stop signal (4.0 +0/−1 Hz with filament bulbs). Check the LED driver, control and photometry in flashing mode for this. Alternatively, document with the OEM that the ESS is implemented via the direction indicators.

deviations.topic: Mandatory INMETRO certification for replacement bulbs
deviations.national_requirement: Portaria Inmetro nº 145/2022: automotive filament bulbs of certain categories for the aftermarket must be certified, registered with INMETRO and carry the conformity seal (Art. 6 and 7). These include P21W, P21/5W, PY21W, R5W, R10W, W5W, W21W, W21/5W, C5W and H21W. Exempt are components for the vehicle assembly line (Art. 3 § 7 I) and unlisted categories; complete lamps are out of scope. All automotive bulbs must show the international category designation on the packaging (Art. 9).
deviations.suggestion: If the lamp uses replaceable filament bulbs of a listed category: state the international bulb category in the specification. Also make sure that INMETRO-certified and registered bulbs with the conformity seal are available for the Brazilian aftermarket.

deviations.topic: Owner's manual: document lamp functions and permitted bulbs
deviations.national_requirement: Res. CONTRAN 970/2022 Art. 8: the identification, position and correct use of the lighting and signalling devices must be described in the vehicle or equipment manual. Art. 11: original bulbs may only be replaced with bulbs of a different wattage or technology if the manual or an official document from the vehicle manufacturer allows it. Violations are penalised under Art. 230 XIII CTB (Art. 15 VII b).
deviations.suggestion: Provide the OEM with the information for the Brazilian owner's manual: functions and position of the rear lamp, operation, permitted bulb categories or a note that LED modules are not replaceable. Specify in the specification which replacement light sources are permitted.
